about_the_game:
Music for Storytelling and World Building resembling old games aesthetics from the 80's and 90's

- Content:

10 original tracks made with old school tones and sounds, ready to creative

immersive moments in your game, including:

. 5 Battle Theme Tracks

. 3 Town Theme Tracks

. 2 Storytelling Tracks

All tracks are at least 2 minutes long and loopable.

*******************************************

Audio: 10 tracks (wav, ogg, m4a)

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
